Indian Commerce Minister to Visit European Countries

Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal will lead a business delegation to Spain, Belgium, and Finland from July 13, aiming to boost trade and investment ties with Europe. The delegation includes representatives from various Indian companies across different sectors. This visit comes as the government is defending the US trade deal, which critics say is one-sided.
